strings.seo.why[0].title: 100% ka nɔgɔ
strings.seo.why[0].text: Sarali tɛ, kadi tɛ, tamasimɛ tɛ i ka sɛbɛnw kan.

strings.seo.why[1].text: Tɔgɔ sɛbɛnni tɛ: da yɔrɔ da, i ka fayiluw gosi, a ban na.
strings.seo.why[2].title: I ka fayiluw bɛ i ta ye
strings.seo.why[2].text: A baara kɛna, ka bɔ yen. An tɛ i ka sɛbɛnw ni i ka kibaruw mara.
strings.seo.why[3].title: Format bɛɛ
strings.seo.why[3].text: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, foto, EPUB… kompyuta wala telefon na.
strings.seo.howTitle: A bɛ baara kɛ cogo di?
strings.seo.faqTitle: Ɲiningali minw bɛ kɛ tuma bɛɛ
strings.seo.faq[0].a: Awɔ. Minɛn bɛɛ ka nɔgɔ, tamasimɛ tɛ, fɛn tɛ min mara sɔrɔli kɔnɔ. Kadi tɛ ɲinin.
strings.seo.faq[1].q: N ka ɲi ka tɔgɔ sɛbɛn?
strings.seo.faq[1].a: Ade. Tɔgɔ sɛbɛnni tɛ, email tɛ: i bɛ minɛnw baara kɛ fo.
strings.seo.faq[2].q: I bɛ n ka sɛbɛnw mara?
strings.seo.faq[2].a: Ade. I ka fayiluw bɛ baara kɛ ni u ye tuma kelenpe, ka bɔ yen. Mɔgɔ tɛ u kalan fana u tɛ ɲɛn.
strings.seo.faq[3].q: A bɛ baara kɛ telefon na?
strings.seo.faq[3].a: Awɔ. pdff bɛ baara kɛ telefon, tablet wala kompyuta (Android, iPhone, Windows, Mac, Linux) browser kɔnɔ, fɛn tɛ don.
strings.seo.faq[4].a: PDF, Word (DOCX, DOC), Excel (XLSX, XLS, CSV), PowerPoint (PPTX, PPT), OpenDocument (ODT, ODS, ODP), RTF, foto (JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF, GIF, SVG), EPUB, TXT, HTML ni wɛrɛw.
strings.seo.faq[5].q: A yɔrɔ bɛ se yɔrɔ jumen?
strings.seo.faq[5].a: I bɛ se ka fayilu {files} baara kɛ tuma kelen na, ni sɛbɛn min bɛ bɔ a se ka folli {pages} sɔrɔ.
strings.privacy.title: Sɛbɛn tanga
strings.privacy.description: Cogo min na pdff bɛ i ka fayiluw minɛ: tɔgɔ tɛ, sɛbɛn tɛ mara, ad tɛ ni kibaruw bɛɛ ka tanga.
strings.privacy.intro: pdff labɛnna walasa i ka sɛbɛnw ka to i ta ye. Yan bɛ mɛn na, cogo min na a bɛ baara kɛ.
strings.privacy.sections[0].title: I ka fayiluw
strings.privacy.sections[0].text: U bɛ ci (HTTPS) ni tanga ye, ka baara kɛ yɛrɛma, ka bɔ yen sɔrɔminɛ. Fayilu belebelew bɛ taa yɔrɔ bon na ni tɔgɔ wɛrɛ ye ka bɔ yen baara ban na; yɔrɔkɔrɔ bɛ fɛn bɛɛ bɔ awa ti 24 kɔnɔ.
strings.privacy.sections[1].title: Tɔgɔ sɛbɛnni tɛ, kibaruw tɛ
strings.privacy.sections[1].text: pdff tɛ tɔgɔ sɛbɛnni ɲini, email tɛ, kadi tɛ. I ka sɛbɛnw tɛ kalan, tɛ lajɛ, tɛ taa ni ɲɛn, tɛ fana baara kɛ ni inteligansi ye.
strings.privacy.sections[2].title: Minɛn lajɛli
strings.privacy.sections[2].text: An bɛ taama lajɛ ka tɛ tɔgɔ don ni cookie tɛ (Vercel Web Analytics) walasa ka minɛn minw ka ɲi ka dɔn. Ad tɛ, taama lajɛ tɛ.
strings.privacy.sections[3].title: Cookies
strings.privacy.sections[3].text: Cookie kelen dɔrɔn: a bɛ kan min sugandinnen don lajɛ.
strings.privacy.sections[4].title: Bɔyɔrɔ
strings.privacy.sections[4].text: A bɛ Paris server na Vercel fɛ; Word, Excel ni PowerPoint yɛlɛmali bɛ Frankfurt Render fɛ. Minɛn ninw bɛ fayiluw minɛ yɛlɛmali waati dɔrɔn.
strings.privacy.sections[5].title: Sɔrɔli
strings.privacy.sections[5].text: Ɲiningali wala kɔnɔko? I bɛ se ka se an na baara yɔrɔ na:
